_note: Carp identification config. Hierarchy: genus -> species -> iaClass -> _id_conf. The three carp types (common / mirror / koi) are iaClasses under Cyprinus.carpio. Matching (getMatchingSetQuery) filters candidates by iaClass, so a mirror only ever matches mirrors, a koi only koi, etc. Identification uses HotSpotter, which needs NO trained model -- good for the first end-to-end test. The _detect_conf model tags (carp_v0) only matter once you train a detector/labeler (Rung 3); until then you annotate manually and detection is not invoked.

carpio._note: Rung 3 only. This detector/labeler config is inert until you register a trained model as tag 'carp_v0' in WBIA (densenet.ARCHIVE_URL_DICT / lightnet.CONFIG_URL_DICT). For the first test you draw annotations by hand and pick the iaClass, so this block is not used.
